channel.title: Zubu Tunes
channel.description: New kids songs from Zubu Tunes

item.title: Stories for Kids 🎈🐻 Red Balloon, Sharing, Sorry & Thank You | Zubu Tunes
item.description: Five short, gentle stories in one video for toddlers and preschoolers: a baby fox looks for her red balloon, friends learn about sharing, saying sorry and saying thank you, and Baby Bear asks a very serious question.

item.title: Good Manners & Healthy Habits for Kids 🍪🦷 Sharing, Sorry, Thank You, Brush Your Teeth | Zubu Tunes
item.description: Four little lessons in one video: sharing is caring, saying sorry, saying thank you and brushing your teeth. Short, gentle stories and counting songs for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Save Some for Later! 🍓🦊🐵 Fox and Monkey Story for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Fox and Monkey have a basket of strawberries for the picnic... but just one more is so hard to resist! Hiding it, climbing trees, even asking Elephant to sit on it. A gentle, funny story about saving some for later and sharing, for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Baby Bear Knows Everything! 🐻🤓 Funny Quiz for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Clever Baby Bear can answer anything Daddy asks... until the cow question! A tiny funny quiz for toddlers and preschoolers: colours, counting and animal sounds.

item.title: Count to 5 & Bath Time! 🛁🐵 Counting Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Count 1 to 5 with three little monkeys playing in the mud! Muddy at 3, soap at 4, splash splash scrub scrub, clean at 5.

item.title: Sleepy Bunny's Lullaby 🐰🌙 Count the Sheep Bedtime Song | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: One little sheep, two little sheep... A slow, gentle lullaby with a sleepy bunny counting sheep. Soft music for bedtime, for babies and toddlers.

item.title: Goodnight, Little Moon 🌙 Soft Lullaby for Babies to Sleep | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Goodnight, little moon, up so high... A soft, slow lullaby with Mommy Penguin and her sleepy baby. Calm music and gentle words for bedtime.

item.title: Guess the Wild Animal Sound! 🐸🐱🦖 Animal Sounds for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Ribbit! Meow! Tweet! ROAR! Listen, guess the animal, then see who it is. Wild animal sounds for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Guess the Animal Sound! 🐮🐑🦆 Farm Animal Sounds for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Moo! Baa! Quack! Who says this? Listen to the sound, guess the animal, then see who it is. Farm animal sounds for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Where Is My Red Balloon? 🎈 Baby Fox Story for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Whoosh! The wind takes Baby Fox's red balloon. Bunny, Elephant and Monkey help him find it. A short story about friends helping friends, for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Serious Question! 🐻 Baby Bear vs Daddy Bear | Funny Kids Story | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Bear has a very serious question for Daddy Bear: why does Mommy call HIM baby? A tiny funny story for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Baby Bear's Funny Faces! 🐻 Happy, Sad, Sleepy, Surprised | Feelings for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Happy, surprised, sleepy, sad... and silly! Guess Baby Bear's feelings and make the faces with him. A tiny feelings video for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Monster Truck Family! 🚚 Vroom Vroom Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Truck, Sister, Brother, Mommy and Daddy Truck... vroom vroom vroom vroom vroom! Race along, splash in the mud and visit the car wash with the monster truck family.

item.title: Penguin Family Waddle! 🐧 Waddle Dance Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Penguin, Mommy, Daddy, Grandma and Grandpa Penguin... waddle waddle waddle waddle! Copy the hands and waddle along. Uh oh, a big wave... splash!

item.title: Thank You! 🐧🎁 Baby Penguin Says Thank You | Good Manners for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Grandma Penguin brings a surprise gift. What does Baby Penguin say? A tiny story about saying thank you for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Sorry! 🐘 Baby Elephant Says Sorry | Good Manners for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Elephant knocks over Kitty's tower by accident. What should he say? A tiny story about saying sorry for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Count to 5 & Wash Your Hands! 🐸🧼 Counting Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Count 1 to 5 with two little frogs jumping in the mud! Muddy hands at 3, soap at 4, clean at 5.

item.title: Count to 10 & Brush Your Teeth! 🦷🪥 Counting Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Count from 1 to 10 with two little teeth! Every egg brings sweets and the teeth get messy... until number 7 brings a toothbrush. Clean and shiny by 10!

item.title: Sharing is Caring! 🍪 Baby Bear Shares His Cookie | Good Manners for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Bear has one cookie and Kitty is hungry. What will he do? A tiny story about sharing for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Bunny Family Hop! 🐰 Hop Hop Dance Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Baby Bunny, Mommy Bunny, Daddy Bunny, Grandma and Grandpa Bunny... hop hop hop hop hop hop! Copy the hands and hop along with the bunny family. Uh oh, a fox! Don't worry, it's a friendly one.

item.title: Zubu and the Lost Star ⭐ Bedtime Story for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: A little star falls from the sky and Zubu helps it find its way home. A gentle bedtime story for toddlers with a narrator and friendly characters.

item.title: Dinosaur Stomp With Zubu! 🦖 Dinosaur Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Stomp, stomp, ROAR! Move like a dinosaur with Zubu. A fun dinosaur action song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Five Little Ghosts! 👻 Halloween Counting Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Five little ghosts came to play... BOO! Count down with Zubu and some very friendly ghosts. A silly Halloween counting song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Peekaboo Pumpkin! 🎃 Halloween Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Peekaboo... BOO! Play peekaboo with Zubu and a friendly pumpkin. A silly, not-scary Halloween song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Zubu's Big Sneeze! 🤧 Funny Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Ah... ah... ACHOO! Zubu has a very big sneeze. A silly, giggly song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Rain Rain Go Away With Zubu 🌧️☀️ Nursery Rhyme for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Rain, rain, go away! Sing the classic nursery rhyme with Zubu and cheer when the sun comes out. A happy song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star With Zubu 🌟 Lullaby for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Twinkle, twinkle, little star! Sing the classic lullaby with Zubu under the night sky. A calm song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Freeze Dance With Zubu! 🕺 Dance and Freeze Game for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Dance, wiggle, jump, spin... and FREEZE! Play the freeze dance game with Zubu. A fun movement song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Count to 5 With Zubu! 🌟 Numbers Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: One, two, three, four, five! Count to 5 with Zubu and his little stars in this numbers song for toddlers and preschoolers.

item.title: Learn Colours With Zubu! 🍎☀️🎈 Colours Song for Kids | Zubu Tunes #shorts
item.description: Red, yellow, blue, green and purple! Learn colours with Zubu in this fun song for toddlers and preschoolers.
